entry.title: REEVES 1.1.4
entry.summary: A Rev2-style bi-timbral poly, 8 or 16 voices: two shape-modulated oscillators, sub, noise, sync, a 4-pole/2-pole low-pass, three envelopes, four LFOs, eight mod slots, an effect per layer, arp, poly and gated sequencers, unison, stack and split. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages per layer.

entry.title: REEVES 1.0.0
entry.summary: REEVES 1.0.0, a 16/8-voice bi-timbral poly in the manner of the Sequential Prophet Rev2. VST3 + Standalone for Windows, VST3 + AU + Standalone for the Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel), and a plugin for Akai MPC hardware. Mac: use the .tar.gz, then run xattr -cr on the plugins (see README).
